Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
AGENDA ITEMS
2A.
Leucadia Streetscape Corridor: Redesign of Safety and Mobility Enhancements along North Coast Highway 101 (CS22A) and Funding for Leucadia Streetscape Segment C (CS04D). Contact Person: Acting City Engineer Bankston
1) Approve redesign and rebid of the Safety and Mobility Enhancements along North Coast Highway 101 project for consistency with the ultimate Leucadia Streetscape vision and to create a separate bike lane.
2) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, with project designer Michael Baker International (MBI) in the amount of: $85,570 plus 15 percent contingency ($12,835) for a total task amount of $98,405 for roadway design services and creation of a construction bid package to redesign the Safety and Mobility Enhancements Along North Coast Highway 101 project; and, $243,070 plus 15 percent contingency ($36,460) for a total task amount of $279,530 for roadway design services and creation of a construction bid package for Segment C of the Leucadia Streetscape Project with additive alternates. The total not-to-exceed amount, with contingency for these two tasks on the Leucadia Streetscape contract would be $377,935. 3) Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney, with landscape designer Peltz and Associates in the amount of $139,800 plus 15 percent contingency ($20,970), for a total contract amendment not to exceed amount of $160,770 for landscape design services and creation of a construction bid package for Segment C of the Leucadia Streetscape Project with additive alternates. 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-73 entitled "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget" (Attachment 3 of the agenda report) to fund redesign of Safety and Mobility Enhancements Along North Coast Highway 101, preparation of roadway and landscape final bid packages for Segment C of Leucadia Streetscape, communication and outreach services, and a temporary senior engineer position to manage the next Leucadia Streetscape segment. 5) Approve staff contact with resource agencies to obtain required environmental documentation and permits for Leucadia Streetscape Segment C and the redesigned Safety and Mobility Enhancements Along North Coast Highway 101 project.

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
